author: Ethan
scope: Runner cancellation polling and terminal cleanup

observedBeforeFix: Queued cancellation-store exception escaped the interval as an uncaught exception.
Injected final save failure did not reject delegation.
Injected final event failure escaped as a raw error and left the capability file behind.
Non-ENOENT capability unlink failure was swallowed and delegation returned normally.

behavior: Cancellation polling failures abort through a generic STORE_CANCEL_CHECK_FAILED reason and are observed by normal async control flow.
Final save/event failures return generic classified errors, release the claimed slot, and attempt to persist FAILED after a partial terminal write.
Capability removal ignores only ENOENT; other failures are classified and prevent success reporting.
Process signal listeners and timer callbacks are removed before final storage operations.
Failed or interrupted runs retain staged workspace and original-file recovery copies.
limits: A failed filesystem write may prevent the best-effort FAILED replacement from persisting; delegation rejects and does not return a successful Run in that case.
The controlled-store tests avoid real providers and network requests; they do not qualify provider compatibility.
